official: 八王子市下水道条例の一部を改正する条例設定について
name: 非常時に他市町村の指定工事店も工事可能に
summary: 排水設備などの工事は、八王子市長の指定を受けた工事店が行うことになっています。災害などの非常時に、市長が必要と認めた場合は、他の市町村の指定を受けた工事店も工事できるようになります。
changes: 災害などの非常時に、他市町村の指定工事店が工事できる例外を設ける
who: 排水設備などの工事を必要とする住民
他の市町村の指定工事店

en.name: Allows contractors designated by other municipalities to work during emergencies
en.official: Regarding the enactment of an ordinance to partially amend the Hachioji City Sewerage Ordinance
en.summary: Work on drainage facilities and similar infrastructure must be carried out by contractors designated by the mayor of Hachioji City. During emergencies such as disasters, contractors designated by other municipalities will also be allowed to carry out the work if the mayor deems it necessary.
changes: Allows contractors designated by other municipalities to carry out work during emergencies such as disasters
who: Residents who need work on drainage facilities and similar infrastructure
